item.content:encoded:
This file is a SAMPLE — delete it once you've written your first real entry. It exists only to prove build.py works and to show the markdown shapes it understands.

The filename (example-entry.md) doesn't matter — everything that matters (title, date, and the URL slug) is set right here at the top of the file, in the three lines between the --- marks.

A log is one session: the problem you were holding, how long you held it, and what came out.

A subheading looks like this

Ordinary paragraphs. Bold, italic, and inline code all work. So do links.

  • A list item.
  • Another one.
A quote, if a quote is needed.
